1  JUDGMENT
The above writ petition is preferred challenging Ext.P12 order.

During the pendency of the writ petition, the 2 nd respondent Secretary has issued Ext.P22 communication directing the petitioner to appear before the 2 nd respondent on 15.04.2025 at 11 a.m., which appears to be in the form of a show cause notice.
However, the petitioner apprehends that as the writ petition is pending consideration, the 2 nd respondent Secretary will not hear the petitioner.
In the above said circumstances the writ petition is closed, granting liberty to the petitioner to approach the Secretary as directed in Ext.P22.
However, closure of this writ petition will not preclude the petitioner from approaching this Court, if any adverse orders are passed by the 2 nd respondent.
For the purpose of appearing, the 2nd respondent Secretary shall issue further notice to the petitioner intimating the date of hearing.

While appearing 2025:KER:32908 before the 2nd respondent Secretary, the petitioner's contention with respect to the deemed licence shall also be considered in accordance with law, within a period of one month from the date of appearing.

Sd/-
